review_candidates.description: Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies with over 25 years of history and one of the global leaders in social discovery. We build products that redefine the way people interact with each other, form relationships, and combat loneliness. Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures in different parts of the world. The company started with dating services like Dating.com, but today our business is much broader. We develop niche online-communication platforms tailored to different audiences — from users aged 40+ to communities united by shared interests, culture, or lifestyle. We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025). We are looking for Senior Atlassian Platform Engineer . Your main tasks will be: Administer Jira Server / Data Center, Confluence, and Atlassian Cloud environments. Configure and support workflows, permissions, dashboards, JQL, automations, integrations, and plugins. Monitor Jira performance, troubleshoot issues, and improve platform stability and reliability. Support maintenance, upgrades, housekeeping, and incident resolution. Improve Jira governance and reduce configuration debt. Automate routine administrative tasks using ScriptRunner, REST API, and scripting tools. Collaborate with Infra, SRE, DBA, and engineering teams to resolve system and performance issues. We expect from you: 3+ years of experience with Jira Server / Jira Data Center and Confluence administration. Strong hands-on experience with Jira as a critical internal platform, including workflows, permissions, custom fields, users, groups, dashboards, JQL, and reporting. Experience troubleshooting Jira Server issues: logs, indexing, performance bottlenecks, slow queries, plugins, and integrations. Understanding of Jira architecture, JVM basics, indexing, and performance impact of customizations. Experience working with REST API, ScriptRunner, webhooks, and administrative automation. Ability to write and maintain Groovy, Python, or Bash scripts for operational tasks. Experience with Jira / Confluence Cloud administration will be a plus. Fluent Russian and intermediate (B1) or higher English level. What do we offer: REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time; Vacation 28 calendar days per year; 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave; Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company; 50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings; Corporate discount for English lessons; Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children); Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years; Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc. Sounds good? Join us now! The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment.

review_candidates.title: Regional Service Delivery Manager, End User Services
review_candidates.location: Kallang, Central Singapore Community Development Council, Singapore
review_candidates.description: Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage set us apart. Role Purpose Own end-to-end governance and service outcomes for Global Service Desk, End User Services and Procurement within the region, acting as the accountable retained-organization leader in a “2-in-a-box” partnership with the Capgemini Regional Delivery Lead. This is a dedicated Service Delivery Manager (SDM) role — focused on governance, vendor management, and operational leadership — and is distinct from a site support engineer role. The SDM provides the clear, accountable chain that the retained organization currently lacks, closing today's escalation gap. Key Responsibilities Service Delivery Governance Own governance of Global Service Desk, End User Field Support and Procurement delivery within the region; serve as the accountable escalation point for a director-level chain of ownership. Chair joint (“2-in-a-box”) governance with the Capgemini Regional Delivery Lead, including daily stand-ups, shared dashboards, ticket aging reviews, and monthly operational reviews. Ensure that tickets opened more than 10 days automatically triggers joint ownership and proactive engagement with the affected user. Vendor & SOP Governance Own review and approval of SOPs developed by Capgemini; drive documentation currency and completion for all in-region processes. Hold Capgemini accountable to agreed delivery standards under the Service Improvement Plan (SIP), escalating partner-performance gaps through the appropriate channel. Asset & Hardware Lifecycle Own inventory visibility, spares management, procurement planning, and hardware lifecycle governance for the region. Smart Lockers Own smart locker operational processes: employee provisioning, spare allocation, return-locker strategy, capacity planning, and retention periods. Operational Excellence & Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) Establish and run structured operational reviews, backlog governance, and trend analysis to drive measurable service improvement. Own the regional CSI roadmap in partnership with Capgemini. Executive Support & Business Relationship Own the regional business stakeholder relationship, including executive support governance and escalation handling. Conduct regular site visits, including joint visits with Capgemini leadership, to maintain visibility and strengthen local stakeholder relationships. Field Support Optimization Assess site-by-site criticality, user population, and operational complexity to determine where dedicated onsite (OSS) resources are warranted. Partner with Capgemini to shape the sourcing model for those sites, including where dedicated Capgemini engineers should replace subcontracted resources. Required Qualifications & Experience 8+ years in IT service delivery or end user services management, including 3+ years in a formal Service Delivery Manager or vendor governance role. Proven experience governing outsourced/managed service provider relationships (SLAs, escalation management, joint operating models), ideally across a multi-tower environment (Service Desk and Field Support). Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned service management practices (incident, problem, change). Track record of building and running operational governance rhythms — stand-ups, operational reviews, dashboards, ticket aging and backlog governance. Experience with IT asset lifecycle management, hardware logistics, or smart locker / self-service equipment models is an advantage. Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable engaging regional business leaders and executives. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience; ITIL Foundation certification preferred. Service Now, Jira, Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft O365, Mac iOS. Key Skills & Competencies Governance and accountability mindset — owns outcomes, not just oversight. Vendor and partner management, including constructive challenge in a joint governance model. Data-driven operational management: KPIs, dashboards, and trend analysis. Cross-functional leadership without direct authority (“2-in-a-box” collaboration). Clear, confident communicator, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders. Structured and process-oriented, with the ability to operate through organizational change.
